jia: Quick smoke — bringing up vectorization v2 on staging (vectorization://v2-mit/quant-int8). Ran recall@1/5 on wiki-small. Preliminary numbers look odd.
omar: Can you paste the eval summary?
jia: Summary snapshot:
```
recall@1   baseline(fp16): 0.73  -> v2-int8: 0.67
recall@5   baseline(fp16): 0.91  -> v2-int8: 0.88
silhouette baseline: 0.42 -> v2-int8: 0.40
```
Looks like a small but consistent drop across metrics.
sasha: Are you using per-channel quant or per-tensor? Which quant path/onnx opset?
jia: Right now per-tensor symmetric via ONNX int8 path (ops 15). Command used: `python eval_vectors.py --model v2 --quant int8 --dataset wiki-small --k 5`
cory: Any difference when using dot-product vs cosine similarity?
jia: Good call — reran with dot: recall@1 gap reduced (0.73 -> 0.70). Cosine is showing larger sensitivity to scale shifts.
omar: Can you try per-channel quant and an L2-normalize-before-quant variant? Per-channel often reduces directional bias.
jia: Kicking those off now. Also trying a tiny pipeline change: `emb = normalize(clip(emb, -5,5))` before quant.
deploy-bot: :rocket: model-deploy: v2-int8 pushed to staging cluster s-gpu-4 at 2026-03-20T10:12:34Z
sasha: FYI clustering checks (UMAP+kmeans) show purity drop: 0.78 -> 0.70 on v2-int8, aligns with recall regression.
jia: Hypothesis: quantization introduces small additive bias that affects cosine after L2. If pre-normalize eliminates the bias we can avoid fp16 fallback.
cory: If pre-normalize helps, that's a cheap inference fix. If not, we should consider shipping a quant-aware calibration or per-channel route.
omar: Also run recall@k for k=[1,5,10] and an adversarial paraphrase holdout — k=1 can be noisy.
jia: Will run full sweep and attach results to the PR. If recall@1 drops > 0.02 vs baseline we'll enable the fp16 fallback for production routes. @here :eyes:
sasha: sounds good. thanks for the quick checks.
cory: SG. Ping when per-channel + normalize jobs finish and paste the short CSV output.
jia: Will do — ETA ~20m.
